name: GLEIF LEI API
summary: Free JSON:API access to the Global LEI Index: legal entity identifiers, names, addresses, status and ownership relationships.
description: Searchable API over the GLEIF Golden Copy: LEI records with legal name, jurisdiction, legal and headquarters address, registration status and managing LOU, plus direct and ultimate parent relationships, LEI issuers, countries and ISIN-to-LEI and BIC-to-LEI mappings via filters. Names can be searched with fuzzy completion. Responses follow the JSON:API format with pagination.

rate_limit.summary: 60 requests per minute per user for all users, per the Postman-hosted API docs.

coverage.geographic: Global; about 3.49 million LEI records at check time

agent_notes: Search by exact filter[lei], filter[entity.legalName], filter[isin] or filter[bic]; use /fuzzycompletions when you only have a partial name and then fetch the record by LEI. Use page[size] to control size. The meta.pagination block gives totals. Content type is application/vnd.api+json. Bulk files (Golden Copy) are the better route for the whole index.
caveats: page[size] is a bracketed parameter that must be URL-encoded (page%5Bsize%5D) in some clients.
A name filter matches the exact legal name; Siemens AG returned 14 records.
No OpenAPI document found; docs are a Postman collection.
A /isins endpoint returned 404; ISIN lookups work through lei-records?filter[isin]=.

verification.notes: Example executed keyless: 200. lei-records list (3,490,817 records), name filter, fuzzycompletions, lei-issuers, countries and filter[isin] also 200. CORS * on two origins.
